max_startups.description: Maximum number of concurrent login negotiations in progress (unauthenticated). Raise on high-traffic hosts.

login_title.description: Text shown in the browser tab title and as the heading on the cockpit login page.

allowed_origins.description: Allowed HTTP origins. Each entry must include scheme and hostname (e.g. https://server.example.com). Leave empty to accept whatever origin the browser sends.

protocol_header.description: Request header injected by a reverse proxy to indicate the original protocol. Set only when cockpit sits behind nginx/Apache/haproxy. Leave empty for direct exposure.

allow_unencrypted.description: Accept plain HTTP connections. Set to true only in isolated LANs or dev environments; never in production.

url_root.description: URL path prefix when cockpit is reverse-proxied under a subdirectory (e.g. /cockpit). Leave empty to serve from /.

compression.description: Enable gzip compression of static web assets. Disable only if a terminating proxy already compresses responses.

client_cert_auth.description: Require a valid X.509 client certificate for authentication. Enables smart-card and PKI login flows.

login_banner.description: Absolute path to a plain-text file displayed on the cockpit login page (e.g. legal notice). Leave empty to show no banner.

session_idle_timeout.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a session is automatically terminated. Set 0 to disable the idle timeout.

session_banner.description: Absolute path to a plain-text file shown as a message-of-the-day immediately after login. Leave empty for no post-login banner.

log_fatal.description: Destination for fatal-level log messages. Accepted values: stderr (journald captures it) or syslog.

oauth_enabled.description: Add an [OAuth] section and redirect unauthenticated users to the OAuth provider. Requires oauth_url.

oauth_url.description: Full URL of the OAuth 2.0 provider endpoint. Required when oauth_enabled is true (e.g. https://sso.example.com/oauth/authorize).
